title: Ferretti Yachts INFYNITO 80
highlights: Fast-displacement hull, 1,000 nm range at 12 knots
End-to-end main deck with near 360° views
description:
The INFYNITO range is changing the paradigm of fast-displacement yachts, with enhanced space, versatile layouts, increased volume and an eco-sustainable soul. This new 2026 INFYNITO 80 features an end-to-end main deck with an open-space concept and almost 360-degree panoramic views.

Her fast-displacement hull reaches up to 22 knots while achieving a range of 1,000 nautical miles at an economic 12 knots. Four guest cabins and two crew. Price quoted ex-shipyard.
